title: Convert BST to Greater Tree
summary: Given the root of a Binary Search Tree (BST), convert it to a Greater Tree such that each node's value is updated to the original value plus the sum of all values greater than the original value in the BST.
statement: Given the root of a Binary Search Tree (BST), convert it to a Greater Tree such that each node's value is updated to the original value plus the sum of all values greater than the original value in the BST.
constraints: root is a BST with distinct integer values.
Replace each value by its original value plus all original values greater than it.

reference_solution:
def convert_bst_to_greater_tree(root):
    total=0
    def visit(node):
        nonlocal total
        if node is None:return
        visit(node.right);total+=node.val;node.val=total;visit(node.left)
    visit(root);return root
